---
title: "Portfolio"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
```

Interactive data visualizations Brian has contributed to.

```{r}
portfolio <- read_csv("data/portfolio.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

portfolio %>%
  mutate(
    image_path = file.path("images/portfolio", image),
    has_image = file.exists(image_path),
    thumb_html = ifelse(
      has_image,
      glue("<img src='{image_path}' class='portfolio-thumb' alt='{title}'>"),
      "<div class='portfolio-thumb portfolio-thumb-placeholder'></div>"
    )
  ) %>%
  glue_data(
    "<a class='portfolio-card' href='{url}' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>\n\n",
    "{thumb_html}\n\n",
    "<div class='portfolio-card-body'>\n\n",
    "**{title}**\n\n",
    "<span class='meta'>{description}</span>\n\n",
    "</div>\n\n",
    "</a>\n"
  ) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  {glue("<div class='portfolio-grid'>\n\n{.}\n\n</div>")} %>%
  cat()
```
